description: Memory tools for storing and retrieving persistent facts, decisions, preferences, and notes across conversations.

memory_search.description: Search your long-term memory for facts, decisions, preferences, and notes from past conversations using keyword search. Use this when you need to recall information the user has told you before.

query.description: Keywords to search for in memory

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20)

tags.description: Optional — only return entries that have all of these tags

memory_update.description: Save or update an important fact, decision, preference, or note so you can recall it in future conversations. Use this when the user tells you something you should remember permanently. To update an existing memory, provide 'old_text' with a unique substring of the original content. Use target='user' to save user preferences separately. The same topic is automatically reused across calls — saving with an existing topic updates that entry rather than creating a duplicate.

topic.description: Short topic label for this memory. Reusing an existing topic updates that entry in-place.

content.description: The fact, decision, preference, or note to remember

memory_type.description: How long to remember this: long_term (permanent), daily (day-scoped), session (current conversation only)

old_text.description: Unique substring of existing memory content to update (omit to create new)

target.description: Where to save: 'memory' for workspace facts, 'user' for user preferences and profile

tags.description: Optional labels for grouping this entry (e.g. ["persona", "exometeorology"]). Search by tag to find all related entries.
